preconditions.description: The number of servers n must be between 3 and 100,000.
The number of direct connections m must be between 0 and 100,000.
The index of the server that fails v must be between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if m < n - 1 else True
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to connect the servers in the required way, output -1.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.splitlines()) == m + 1 if m >= n - 1 else True
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, it must contain m lines describing the direct connections.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= n and 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= n for line in stdout.splitlines() if line != '-1')
postconditions.description: Each direct connection must link two valid server indices.
